URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy0j9yyed1lo
BBC News, 21 Jul 2026 — Two firefighters died battling a blaze near Bordeaux-Mérignac airport (Gironde), flights delayed. Separate out-of-control fire in Var (Pontevès), 600 firefighters, 150 evacuated. France registered nearly 11,000 fires since start of year; >42,000 hectares burned Jan-mid-July (Effis) — surpassing previous record set 2022. Macron: most blazes since WWII. Spain: at least 13 killed; 29,000 ha burned north of Madrid. Driven by prolonged heatwaves. (Ref: Le Parisien 21 Jul; Interior Min Laurent Nuñez warned of "severe risk" for south-west/south-east this week.)
